name: com.oylist/oylist
title: OyList
description: Create, edit, and publish OyList lists, and search for subjects to add as entries.

tools.name: get_list_guide
tools.description: Read OyList's own guidance, taken from its website, to guide the user while they make a list. Without a topic: the writing tips, what the available list settings mean, how the list score works, and the help topics. With a topic: OyList's answers to common questions on it (creating, visibility, copying, contributions, images, sorting).

topic.description: A help topic to read in full.

profile.description: The username of the profile to work as. Needed only when the connection has several profiles; the user chooses it.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read what the account has used and has left today: OyList's daily allowances for new lists, new items and asset searches, and this connection's budgets for tool calls, edits, asset selections and uploads, each with its reset time. Reading uses none of them beyond the call itself.

tools.name: create_list_draft
tools.description: Create a draft using the supplied title, category, list type, and visibility.

title.description: The list title. Write a title and short introduction that explain what brings the list together.

description.description: The introduction shown under the title. Add a description to let others know why this list matters. A great description can invite comments and make your list more engaging!

categoryId.description: A category ID from list_categories. Select the category that best fits your list. This helps others discover your list and allows us to provide tailored suggestions and resources to make your list creation easier and more accurate.

listType.description: ITEMS: With items type, you can add structured items valid to your selected category, such as movies, books, or products. IMAGES: With images type, you create a gallery of images. Perfect for collections like favorite movie scenes, artwork, or celebrity pictures.

visibility.description: PUBLIC: With public visibility, anyone can search for your list, add votes or leave a comment. UNLISTED: With unlisted visibility, your list can only be seen and shared by those with a link. Only the owner can view a draft until it is published.

allowCopy.description: Recommended on for a public list. Let others build on your list while keeping each item attributed to its original creator. People can recreate a list manually; copying keeps that credit intact. You can always copy your own lists. If you allow copying, anyone with the link can copy your unlisted list and publish their copy publicly.

contribution.description: USER: By selecting just me, only you will be able to add items to your list. This gives you complete control over the content. PUBLIC: By selecting everyone, you will allow other users to suggest items for your list. All contributions will require your approval before they become visible.

contributionRules.description: For a list open to everyone. Written rules you judge yourself when you review. Automatic checks stop an item before it is submitted. Written rules are shown to contributors and judged by you at review.

contributionChecks.description: Automatic checks for a list open to everyone. The site refuses an item that fails one of these, before it reaches you. In a gallery: The site refuses a photo that fails one of these, before it reaches you. Automatic checks stop an item before it is submitted. Written rules are shown to contributors and judged by you at review.

itemImageStyle.description: For an ITEMS list. PORTRAIT (2:3): Your pictures fit inside a tall frame on the list. SQUARE (1:1): Your pictures fit inside a square frame on the list. You can upload pictures of any shape and pick a different crop in the editor.

defaultSort.description: This determines how items are sorted when visitors first view your list. They can still change the sort order themselves. POSITION is the order the owner arranges.

requestId.description: A unique ID for this write. Reuse it when retrying the same request.

profile.description: The username of the profile to work as. Needed only when the connection has several profiles; the user chooses it.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Add up to 100 supplied entries. Provide an asset ID for a matching linked subject or provide a title and assetType for an unlinked entry, with a description and image when available. A title supplied with an asset ID becomes its own title, shown above the linked subject: use it when the entry is a moment, quote, or aspect of that subject.

imageId.description: A picture uploaded through this connection, or, on an Items list, the picture of the subject the entry is linked to. An entry linked to a subject shows that subject's picture when this is left out.

tools.name: get_image_upload_link
tools.description: Create a 10-minute upload link for one JPEG, PNG, or WebP file just under 10 MiB. If you hold the file and can make HTTP requests, post it yourself as directUpload describes (multipart field "image" with the Authorization header) and read the image ID from the reply. Otherwise give the user uploadUrl, a page where they sign in to OyList and choose the file, then call get_image_upload_status.

tools.name: upload_image_from_address
tools.description: Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP picture from the public web address the user chose, just under 10 MiB. Give the https address of the picture file itself, not the page showing it. OyList downloads it and applies its usual image checks. Verify what the picture shows before using it.
